prompt:
Create ONE full-body LEFT-facing WEST walk contact-B game sprite of the SAME original iron Guardian, with a clean transparent background. Do not reverse the leg or arm phase.

On the second reference, REMOVE EVERY orange/gold crack line within the flat plates of helmet, shoulder, chest, forearm, thigh, knee, shin and boots. Replace those thin web-like lines with continuous dark iron surface and sparse non-luminous pitting. No luminous top knob, no glow on rivets, no gold veins, no brown glow or aura. Retain original compact squat mass, short thighs, layered skirt and massive fists, small domed riveted helmet; do not lengthen torso or legs. Keep enough neutral-value separation to read the connected joints. Hand-painted 2D isometric RPG sprite style matching the first reference. Complete single figure, generous fully transparent margin on all sides, 1536x1024 canvas. NO ground, shadow, haze, particles, captions, other bodies or cast shadow. Preserve the correct contact-B support and arm counter-swing.
